name: one last time.
source:
[i]You asked me for one last road trip. I'm your best friend. Of course I said yes.[/i]

This story is a stand alone AU of a short story written years ago, "Vill I. An's School for Terrible Boys and Girls".

[edited from [url=https://pumpkin-spike.itch.io/one-last-time]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[i]你问我最后一次公路旅行。我是你最好的朋友。我当然答应了。[/i]

这个故事是多年前写的短篇小说《维尔一安的糟糕男孩女孩学校》的独立AU。

[编辑自[url=https://pumpkin-spike.itch.io/one-last-time]itch.io[/url]]
